title: 新型医疗AI平台自动化流程

summary: 新加坡推出医疗AI平台自动化医护日常任务，使医护人员能专注于患者护理。
summaryEn: Singapore is rolling out an agentic AI platform for healthcare to automate routine clinical workflows, enabling healthcare professionals to focus more on patient care.
